summary: Read-only: turn each ranked perf lever (decoder/vit P1-epilogue fusion, mamba M0/M1, substrate S1/S2/S3) into a ready-to-author gated-knob implementation spec with transport-only proof + gate recipe

specs.lever: Decoder P1 fp32-epilogue fusion: fold in_b (qkv) and ff0_b+gelu+X_gact post-loops into the GEMM out() lambda in dectc_forward_tile
specs.knob: SG_TUNED_DEC_EPI_FUSE (default 0 = OFF, byte-identical PTX; 1 = ON). Two independent #if-gated folds under the one knob: (A) in_b qkv-bias fold via new dectc_gemm_fwd_bias; (B) ff0_b+gelu+X_gact fold via new dectc_gemm_fwd_f32_ff0fuse.
specs.summary: The single highest expected-value-per-GPU-cycle authorable lever, and the ONLY one the roadmap JSON's adversarial verification left standing (rank-3 dec_p1_epilogue_fuse_measured; the other 5 designs are confirmed dead-wells or pure scale-enablers). It targets the decoder's now-dominant 56.5% fwd/dX phase — the right model (decoder is GEMM/dW-bound, the one place the maxed primitive's surrounding overhead is the residual lever) — at the LOWEST eng cost of the six (two new specialized GEMM-wrapper variants reusing the already-maxed tc_gemm_block_unpipelined engine + two #if-gated call-site swaps at model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:1529-1539 and 1569-1578; verified the wrapper signatures at 1159-1199 and dec_gelu inline helper exist). Fold B (ff0_b) is BYTE-IDENTICAL transport-only (dectc_gemm_fwd_f32 already emits the exact fp32 wgmma accumulator; v+ff0_b is the same fp32 add relocated into the lambda after wgmma_wait_group<0> drains — no reduction-order change, no atomics, CTA-local fragment-decode order). Fold A (in_b) is a real sub-bf16-ULP bit-change (bf16(v+b) single-round vs shipping bf16(bf16(v)+b) double-round) but in the absorbable direction TOWARD the pinned oracle bf(x@bf(w)^T+in_b); gate-arbitrated. Because the two folds are independently gated, a fold-A gate-RED reverts A alone and keeps B. Authoring cost is small and the relevance is the best-understood of the six.
specs.prereq: HARD, but cheap and gate-free: (1) the decoder re-profile at the shipped 618ms PIPE=1/STAGES=4 build (roadmap rank-2 dec_b1_reprofile_then_decide) must run first — the cited 56.5% fwd/dX + 19.2% B1 shares are STALE (measured at the superseded 920ms build, never re-profiled after the +1.49x ring KEEP shrank P1). (2) a NEW byte-identical coarse clock64 slot must isolate the foldable-pass time within P1 — the existing --fwd-fine profiler instruments only INSIDE the cp.async ring and cannot see the fp32 inter-GEMM epilogue passes (they sit in the uninstrumented 24-26% P1 remainder alongside attention + 2 LN + gelu + the mandatory bf16 dW-operand casts, none of which are foldable). Author ONLY after that slot shows the foldable subset clears the relevance floor. Also lands after the already-queued ViT-B1 (#29) + decoder TILE_M (#30) per the campaign serial order. This is why ready=false: the sizing diagnostic does not yet exist.
specs.gate_recipe: PRE-BUILD: run `python tuning/decoder_bench.py --profile --d 2048 --B 16384` (coarse 5-slot) + `--fwd-fine` at the 618ms build for the current phase table; add+read the new coarse foldable-pass slot. If the foldable bucket is below ~3% of the step, this is a NEUTRAL — do not spend a cycle. FAST_TRIAGE: build OFF — verify byte-identical PTX vs the shipped .so (ptxas -v / nvcc -ptx diff); build ON — nvcc EXIT-0, ptxas reports 0 new spills (the folded lambda adds ~3-4 regs in WG0's epilogue window via the captured ff0pre/X_gact/bias pointers + inline dec_gelu; at the 255-reg pin + zero-margin 1-CTA/SM occupancy this MUST be re-verified not to drop below 1 CTA/SM, cf. the IL=4 / N=256 occupancy class); 1-seed d=2048/B=16384 not-worse signal. FULL GATE: fp64 oracle + A/A/A across 11 decoder cells x seeds {42,7,123}. CRITICAL watch for fold A — it must land within 1e-4 fp32-reorder tol AND pass A/A/A bit-determinism (the gate is the arbiter even for absorbable-direction changes, cf. the IL=4 reject and the ViT-dW gate-RED where CPU-clean-by-construction was necessary-not-sufficient). Fold B must be byte-identical (verify with PTX diff on its site). If fold A gate-REDs, revert A, gate B alone. 3-seed timing: KEEP iff faster on 3+ seeds AND parity-clean at d=2048/B=16384, else REVERT.

specs.lever: Mamba M0 — wgmma the 5 projection GEMMs (in_proj/out_proj/SwiGLU gate/up/down x 2 layers) + decoder-style output-stationary dW; apply the authored scaffold then rewire the per-sample fwd/bwd dispatch to a token-tile P1 + dW-stationary P2
specs.knob: SG_TUNED_MB_PROJ_WGMMA (default 0 = byte-identical to the validated scalar path). Splits cleanly into two sub-levers under the one knob: the fwd-GEMM half (gate-green-by-construction) and the dW half (S1-class parity-risky); land the fwd half alone if the dW half gate-REDs.
specs.summary: Ranked above M1/S* because it is the only structural lever in the mamba lane that could actually move step-time (M1 is a pure placement enabler, M2 is a no-op at kSeq=8), and because its SAFE half is the largest fraction-of-work bet of any non-decoder design: the scaffold is already authored and gated-OFF byte-identical (.perf/M0_mamba_wgmma_projections.patch + the integration-scaffold + the ws-agreement proof), so the remaining work is the body-rewire (the GPU-iteration-gated integration), not greenfield. The fwd GEMM half is transport-only by construction (reuses the silicon-validated dectc tc_gemm_block_unpipelined engine; bf16 operands are __float2bfloat16 of the same fp32 the scalar oracle read; ascending-k unchanged; one-CTA-owns-tile, no atomics). The dW half is needs-parity-fp32-reassoc (per-sample kSeq=8 ascending-s reduce -> full-T ascending-t K-contraction reassociates the fp32 tree; OPTIMIZATION_LEDGER.md:134-135 flags it) and is GPU-only-revalidatable. It ranks BELOW the decoder lever because the body-rewire is substantial engineering (materializing the projection acts/adjoints — which currently live transiently in per-sample MambaSampleSmem — to the MbActs HBM region with correct data-flow sequencing) AND its relevance is the most uncertain of all six: the in-tree witness measures projections at 0.1%-of-wall and the scan dominates at the only placeable bench width (d=128), so even a 10x projection speedup likely moves the step <0.5% unless the profiler overturns that.
specs.prereq: HARD CHAIN (roadmap rank-1 mb_p0_wire_profiler): the mamba per-phase clock64 profiler MUST be built and read FIRST — it is the sole arbiter of the Ledger-vs-PERF_ANALYSIS contradiction (Ledger:137 'scan-DOMINATED, projections minority' vs PERF_ANALYSIS:40,67 'projections 94% of FLOPs'). Until it confirms projections are a meaningful wall share at the best-placeable config (d=128 or d=1024 — d>=1024 busts the 228KB MambaSampleSmem cap, so the verdict is a d=1024 cycle-share + an explicit extrapolation flag, NOT a 1.5B fact), M0 stays DEFER. The META-LESSON (Ledger:142-147) forbids building before the profiler fires. Independent secondary prereq for the SCALE win: M1 (smem restructure) is required to even place mamba at d=2048 — without M1, M0 is a d=128-only proof-of-concept. ready=false because (1) the relevance gate has not fired, (2) the dW half is parity-risky and GPU-only-provable, (3) the body-rewire is the substantial remaining step.
specs.gate_recipe: PRE-BUILD HARD GATE: read the profiler (mb_p0_wire_profiler) at d=128 and d=1024; if projections are sub-floor (<~5% of wall), M0 stays DORMANT. STEP 1: git apply the two .perf scaffolds. STEP 2: body-rewire P0/P1/P2 under #if SG_TUNED_MB_PROJ_WGMMA. STEP 3 codegen screen: nvcc EXIT-0 for {0,1}; OFF must be byte-identical PTX (ptxas -v reg/smem match exactly); confirm host mb_tc_workspace_floats and the kernel carve both advance by mb_proj_wgmma_floats(T) and only that (the ws-agreement proof validates the formula CPU-side; the GPU path must walk the SAME pointers — a dropped layout gate is the ViT-dW IMA class). fp64 oracle gate at d=128 (3 seeds x all mamba cells), SPLIT verdict: fwd-GEMM half expected gate-green by the decoder precedent; dW half is the arbiter at the 1e-4 campaign tol — if it fails, land the fwd half alone (dW tiles keep the scalar per-CTA partial reduce) and stage the dW as a second sub-lever after re-anchoring its oracle. A/A/A gate (output-stationary tile_id%nCTA ownership is A/A/A-safe by construction; confirms no impl bug, cf. the IL=4 A/A/A catch). fast_triage at d=128/B=1024 for a cheap not-worse signal. 3-seed timing: KEEP iff faster on 3+ seeds AND parity-clean.

specs.lever: Mamba M1 — smem/HBM restructure (MambaSampleSmemM1 layout redesign + HBM-backed per-sample activations) to enable d=2048 placement
specs.knob: SG_TUNED_MB_HBM_ACTS (default 0 = current layout, byte-identical PTX; 1 = HBM-backed d-scaling activations + the ~210.8KB redesigned smem struct that fits under the 228KB sm_90 opt-in cap at d=2048). Combinable with SG_MB_BENCH_LAYOUT.
specs.summary: A SCALE-ENABLING lever, not a step-time win: at d=128/d=1024 it gives ZERO step improvement; its entire value is unblocking the d=2048/1.5B run that currently cannot place (MambaSampleSmem 2521KB = 11x over the 228KB cap). Ranked above M0 only on PARITY SAFETY and gate-cheapness of the enablement claim — but BELOW M0 on impact because it changes no bottleneck. The ON path is transport-only-byte-identical by construction: the knob gates an entirely separate struct + execution branch (OFF compiles the original unchanged); the ON restructure only changes STORAGE LOCATION of x_in/z/y_scan/g_pre/u_mlp/h1 (HBM vs smem), and preserves the exact ascending-t (t=kSeq-1..0) bwd order so every dW accumulates += in identical fp32 order — no reassociation. The one delta (fn_xhat recomputed as h_buf[s]*fn_r[s] instead of cached) is algebraically exact, not a tolerance question. It is M0's hard prereq for the SCALE win (mamba can't run d=2048 without it), which is why it must precede the M0-at-scale path even though M0 outranks it for impact.
specs.prereq: Same rank-1 mamba profiler prereq as M0: it must confirm scan is NOT 100% of wall at d=1024 before M1 is worth a cycle — if scan dominates at d=1024 it will dominate at d=2048 (scan scales linearly in kD), so M1 would unlock a d=2048 run that is still scan-bound and possibly REGRESSES vs d=1024 on 4x the HBM traffic (~14ms/step pure acts memory at d=2048/B=16384). Secondary: the d=2048 scalar mamba megakernel has NEVER placed, so there is no pre-existing baseline to gate timing against — the verdict is enablement (occupancy>=1 at d=2048) plus a no-regression check at d=1024. ready=false because the profiler is unbuilt and the perf premise at d=2048 is unconfirmed.
specs.gate_recipe: PREREQUISITE: mb_p0_wire_profiler must show non-scan phases are a measurable share at d=1024. FAST_TRIAGE (codegen, no GPU): nvcc EXIT-0 for SG_TUNED_MB_HBM_ACTS={0,1} x SG_MB_BENCH_LAYOUT={0,1} (all 4); PTX-diff ON-vs-OFF at d=128 byte-identical (the knob touches zero code at d=128 production); static_assert(sizeof(MambaSampleSmemM1)==215908); ws sizer mb_tc_workspace_floats strictly larger ON; AND THE KEY PLACEMENT GATE — at SG_MB_BENCH_LAYOUT=1 (d=2048) cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor>=1 with the new ~215908-byte dyn_smem (if occ<1, M1 fails its only purpose). FP64+A/A/A: run the standard mamba oracle + A/A/A on SG_TUNED_MB_HBM_ACTS=1 at SG_MB_BENCH_LAYOUT=0 (d=128, the only width where the oracle is defined) — ON exercises the restructured fwd+bwd dispatch (~54KB struct + 96KB/sample HBM acts at d=128), confirming the HBM spill/load roundtrip is correct; all 11 cells x seeds {42,7,123} parity-clean + A/A/A deterministic. 3-SEED TIMING: KEEP iff occ>=1 at d=2048 and the d=2048 bench runs (enablement is the win), AND no regression at d=1024 ON-vs-OFF.

specs.lever: ViT P1 fp32-epilogue fusion — fold the fwd inter-GEMM scalar passes (in_b add, out_b+residual, ff0_b, ff2_b+x1-residual) + the bwd dY bf16-cast passes into the GEMM out() lambdas in vittc_forward/backward_tile
specs.knob: SG_TUNED_VIT_P1_EPI_FUSE (default 0 = OFF, byte-identical). Four discrete fwd folds + bwd cast folds; fold (A) qkv in_b is the only parity-bearing one (single vs double round), folds (B)/(C)/(D-bias)/bwd are byte-identical by construction.
specs.summary: The decoder-lever port to ViT — and the META-LESSON's textbook wrong-bottleneck trap, which is why it ranks well below its decoder twin despite near-identical mechanics. The code premise is true (vittc_forward_tile:894-948 has the same 4 GEMM+epilogue passes I verified, with vit_gelu inline), and folds B/C/D-bias/bwd are genuinely byte-identical transport-only. BUT the authoritative ViT profile (Ledger:149-158, measured 2026-06-17) is B1_barrier 51.2% DOMINANT, P1_bwd 23.7%, P1_fwd 21.7%, P2_dW only 3.0% — the foldable scalar loops are a MINORITY of P1, which is itself gated behind the B1 grid-barrier that waits on the SLOWEST CTA. Speeding the average CTA's epilogue does almost nothing until B1 is fixed (#29). This is the exact class that gave the ViT-dW twin only +4.5% AND gate-RED on supergrok2/vit. The roadmap killed vit_p1_epilogue_fuse 3-lens (refuted on bottleneck+mechanism; only parity survives). It is authorable and parity-mostly-safe, but its expected value is low and conditional on B1 already being fixed.
specs.prereq: TWO hard prereqs, both unmet: (1) ViT B1 sub-tiling (#29, SG_TUNED_VIT_P1_SUBTILE_S) must LAND and KEEP first — until B1 is fixed the P1 phase is B1-limited and this lever has near-zero delta; #29 itself may DISSOLVE the P1 wall by redistributing work across the 116 idle CTAs, further shrinking this lever's target. (2) a NEW FINE P1 sub-profiler (clock64 slots inside vittc_forward/backward_tile, byte-identical OFF) must confirm the foldable-pass share clears the relevance floor — the existing 6-slot g_vit_prof only measures P1 at coarse granularity, mixing the epilogue passes into the P1 remainder with LN/attn. ready=false because both prereqs are unbuilt and the lever has high NEUTRAL probability even after them.
specs.gate_recipe: DO NOT AUTHOR until #29 KEEPs AND the FINE P1 sub-profiler shows the foldable share is above ~5% of the post-B1-fix step. FAST_TRIAGE: OFF build byte-identical PTX; 1-seed d=2048/B=1024 (production ViT config) better/worse before the full gate. FP64+A/A/A GATE: standard fp64 oracle + A/A/A across all 11 ViT cells x seeds {42,7,123} — CRITICAL: ViT parity is demonstrably MORE fragile than decoder (the dW twin went gate-RED on supergrok2/vit all 3 seeds), so treat the gate as mandatory-not-advisory and do NOT assume the decoder fold-A precedent makes ViT fold-A safe. Verify B/C/D/bwd byte-identical via PTX diff on those sites; fold A (qkv in_b) must land within 1e-4 fp32-reorder tol + A/A/A. Watch the coalescing regression noted in the design (out() fires in wgmma fragment-scatter order vs the coalesced separate pass; for the Xin/sc.x1 residual reads this may raise L2 pressure — measure with ncu if the gate is marginal). 3-SEED TIMING: KEEP iff faster on 3+ seeds at d=2048/B=1024 AND parity-clean, else REVERT; expected delta LOW.

specs.lever: S1 — 128B smem swizzle on the wgmma A/B operand reads (bank-conflict elimination)
specs.knob: SG_TUNED_WGMMA_SWIZZLE (default wgs::kSwizzleNone = byte-identical OFF; ON = kSwizzle128B). Threads through the 4 descriptor-builder call sites (decoder:752/757, vit:458/462, tile_pipeline:333-334, selftest:103-104) AND the matched XOR pre-permutation in both staging scatter paths.
specs.summary: A substrate-wide micro-lever whose math is parity-clean (transport-only: the XOR is a bijective smem address permutation; the wgmma reads the same bf16 VALUE, accumulates in the same ascending-k order into the same fp32 register; no atomics, deterministic XOR map = A/A/A-safe) — but whose RELEVANCE is the weakest of the authorable set and whose engineering coupling is the most dangerous. It ranks above only the dead-on-arrival S2/S3 because it is at least theoretically buildable. The roadmap refuted it on bottleneck+mechanism: NO profiler counter isolates wgmma-operand-read bank conflicts (the WGMMA bucket lumps issue+commit+wait_group<0>), the dominant cost is the cp.async WAIT drain (43%/56%) already owned by the deeper-ring KEEP, and the K=16 bf16 tile geometry (16B/K-row) largely defeats the all-rows-same-bank pathology 128B swizzle fixes. The CRITICAL risk is not numerics but data-layout coupling: the descriptor swizzle field and the staging scatter dst-address XOR must change atomically across 5 code locations — any subset-only change makes wgmma read the WRONG matrix (the ViT-dW IMA failure class, large error not sub-tolerance).
specs.prereq: HARD ncu measurement gate: run `ncu --metrics l1tex__data_pipe_lsu_wavefronts_mem_shared_op_ld.sum,l1tex__data_bank_conflicts_pipe_lsu_mem_shared_op_ld.sum python tuning/decoder_bench.py --d 2048 --B 16384`. If shared_ld bank conflicts are 0 or <1% of shared_ld wavefronts (which the geometry analysis predicts), the lever targets zero conflicts -> SKIP permanently. Also blocked behind the rank-2 decoder re-profile (to confirm WGMMA is even a relevant in-ring bucket — improbable post the +1.49x WAIT-attacking ring KEEP). ready=false because the ncu conflict measurement does not exist and the geometry predicts a NEUTRAL.
specs.gate_recipe: PRE-BUILD: the ncu conflict measurement above is mandatory — do not author unless it shows non-trivial conflicts on the wgmma smem read path. FAST_TRIAGE: build SWIZZLE=0 and verify byte-identical PTX vs shipping (any diff = the #if guard leaked); build SWIZZLE=1 and run wgmma_selftest (its A=I gate catches a scatter/descriptor mismatch immediately at small N before spending an fp64 cycle); 1-seed d=2048/B=16384 timing. Add the alignment static_asserts (kDecTcSmemB1%1024==0, etc.) gated on SWIZZLE!=0. FP64+A/A/A GATE: 11 decoder cells x seeds {42,7,123} — expected EITHER bit-identical OR within 1e-4 (the permutation changes no arithmetic; any divergence >1e-4 indicates a scatter/descriptor INCONSISTENCY, not fp32 reassoc — revert and fix the scatter, do not treat as a tolerance miss). 3-SEED TIMING: KEEP iff faster on 3+ seeds AND parity-clean; NEUTRAL is the most likely outcome per the geometry analysis — treat as not-positive.

specs.lever: S3 — wgmma_issue_n256 + SG_TUNED_TILE_N=256 (256-wide output tile for the in-kernel ss-wgmma) [adversarially confirmed register-fatal] / S2 — TMA-with-transpose dW operand streaming [superseded by the shipped dW contiguous-staging KEEP]
specs.knob: SG_TUNED_TILE_N=256 (S3; default 128, byte-identical OFF) and SG_TUNED_DEC_DW_TMA=1 (S2; default 0, byte-identical OFF). Bundled at the bottom because BOTH are confirmed non-starters: S3 by register physics, S2 by being already-won via a cheaper mechanism.
specs.summary: The two designs the campaign should NOT author next, kept on the list only as documented dead-ends. S3 is REGISTER-FATAL with high confidence (verified: wgmma.cuh:317 kRegs=N/2 so N=256 needs 128 accumulator regs/thread; the static_assert at :578 locks N to {8,16,32,64,96,128} — 256 is not even in the legal set; with IL=2 production = 256 acc regs alone, +~190 non-acc = 445 >> the 255-reg hard cap that the persistent grid-barrier requires for occ>=1; even IL=1 = 128+189=317 > 255; REPORT.md confirms all kernels pinned at 255 regs zero-margin). The math is parity-clean (N is the output-column dim, orthogonal to ascending-k) — the PERF_ANALYSIS 'parity-risky' label is misframed; the fatal blocker is LAUNCH/OCCUPANCY. TILE_N is already at a measured optimum (128->64 = +51% slower, Ledger:39). S2 is NOT a new lever: the dW contiguous-layout staging (SG_TUNED_DEC_DW_STAGE=1) already shipped as the +2.05x KEEP and captured S2's actual payoff via a cheaper mechanism (one-touch pre-transpose into K-contiguous HBM scratch reusing the proven cp.async ring). TMA-with-transpose would add a CUtensorMap descriptor API, a tma.load.im2col PTX sequence not in the substrate, an arrive_expect_tx mbarrier handshake, and 9 host-side descriptor sets — HIGH eng cost for only a workspace reduction (~161MB scratch reclaim) after STAGE=1 already removed the staging bottleneck.
specs.prereq: S3: a pre-build ptxas -v register check is the binding gate — if Used>255 the kernel won't launch (occupancy 0, 'too many resources', same failure that killed P0 depth-3/4 and the S>=3 ring). Also needs the rank-2 re-profile to confirm tile-N width is even a relevant phase at 618ms. S2: the rank-2 decoder re-profile must show the dW GEMM is still >5-10% of the 618ms step POST-STAGE=1 (the 16.9% figure is from the pre-STAGE=1 920ms build, never re-measured); if dW is <5% post-STAGE=1, S2 is permanently a dead well for the decoder. Both ready=false: S3 because the register physics predicts no-launch (confirmed by adversarial analysis sub_s3_n256_dead), S2 because its payoff is already shipped and its residual gain is workspace-only and unconfirmed.
specs.gate_recipe: S3 FAST_TRIAGE (the launch-or-not gate, BUILD-ONLY, no GPU): build -DSG_TUNED_TILE_N=256 -DSG_TUNED_DEC_GEMM_INTERLEAVE=1 (IL=1, since IL=2xN=256 is impossible); run ptxas -v — if Used>255 STOP (won't launch). Only if <=255: cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocks must return >=1 CTA/SM (the persistent grid-barrier hard-requires it); smem check (sB doubles to 8KB/slot at N=256). Then fp64 gate (11 cells x 3 seeds, transport-only-clean) then 3-seed timing. Expected: DOES NOT LAUNCH. S2 PRE-BUILD: `decoder_bench.py --profile --d 2048 --B 16384`; if slot[3] P2 dW-GEMM <~5% of 618ms (<~30ms), do not author. If >10%: OFF byte-identical PTX vs the STAGE=1 baseline; fp64+A/A/A trivially GREEN by the transport-only proof (but the gate is the arbiter, cf. the ViT-dW IMA from a CUtensorMap mis-construction — verify box_shape/element_stride/global_stride against the cuTensorMap ISA spec); 3-seed timing KEEP iff faster on 3+ seeds (expected benefit is workspace reduction only, MMA utilization already high post-STAGE=1).

synth.notes:
RANKING METHODOLOGY: ordered by expected-impact / GPU-cost, anchored to (a) the maxed decoder primitive (PIPE=1/STAGES=4 + dW contiguous-staging shipped, verified at model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:101/145/186/189 — the GEMM engine itself is knob-converged, so the only decoder headroom is the SURROUNDING fp32 overhead, which is exactly what priority-1 targets), (b) the META-LESSON (each model's bottleneck differs: decoder=GEMM/dW, ViT=B1 51% non-GEMM imbalance, mamba=scan; the decoder GEMM lever does NOT generalize — this is why the ViT-epilogue port drops to #4 despite identical mechanics), (c) transport-only legality (ascending-k fp32 order / A-A-A), and (d) the re-profile prereqs.

ALL SIX ARE ready=false IN THE DESIGNS, CORRECTLY: every one needs a gate-free re-profile or measurement to confirm relevance before earning a ratchet cycle. The ranking is therefore the AUTHORING expected-value order AFTER the two cheap gate-free diagnostics (mamba profiler = roadmap rank-1; decoder 618ms re-profile = roadmap rank-2) run first — those two diagnostics are the literal gating prerequisites and should be the campaign's immediate next GPU-free actions, ahead of authoring any of these six.

KEY CROSS-CHECK vs the roadmap JSON (.perf/perf_lever_sweep_roadmap.json): of these six designs, only the decoder P1 epilogue fuse (my #1) survived the 59-agent 3-lens adversarial verification (it IS roadmap rank-3 dec_p1_epilogue_fuse_measured). The other five map to roadmap-killed entries: ViT-epilogue-fuse (killed 3-lens, wrong-bottleneck), M0 (killed 3-lens, DEFER-standing relevance-unconfirmed + parity-blocked dW), M1 (killed on bottleneck/mechanism, parity-survives, pure placement enabler), S1-swizzle (killed on bottleneck/mechanism, ncu-gated), S3-N256 (confirmed dead-well register-physics). I rank M0 above M1 (M0 can move step-time; M1 is placement-only) and both above the ViT/S1/S3 set, but the parent must understand the roadmap's own verdict: 5 of 6 are deferred-or-dead pending their measurement prereqs, and the serial ratchet's HONEST next move is the two diagnostics, not authoring.

VERIFIED CODE ANCHORS (all DESIGN file:line claims accurate): decoder GEMM wrappers dectc_gemm_fwd / dectc_gemm_fwd_f32 signatures at model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:1159-1199; in_b epilogue loop 1534-1539, ff0_b+gelu loop 1572-1577 (SG_DEC_SEQ=4 not 8, but nrows is the token-tile row count so the fold geometry is unaffected); dec_gelu/vit_gelu inline helpers exist; ViT epilogue sites 894-948 confirmed; wgmma N locked to {8,16,32,64,96,128} at wgmma.cuh:578 (N=256 illegal, S3 dead); kRegs=N/2 at :317; shipped decoder defaults DW_STAGE=1/FWD_PIPE=1/STAGES=4/SPLITK=1. The .STOP_TUNING sentinel is still present (campaign mid-flight). All work here was read-only.

PRIORITY-1 PARITY NUANCE (the one bit-changer worth flagging to the gate): the decoder fold-A (in_b) single-round bf16(v+b) vs shipping double-round bf16(bf16(v)+b) is a sub-bf16-ULP change in the ABSORBABLE direction (toward the pinned oracle bf(x@bf(w)^T+in_b)), but the fp64+A/A/A gate is the arbiter regardless (cf. IL=4 reject, ViT-dW gate-RED). Fold-B (ff0_b) is byte-identical. They are independently #if-gated under the one knob, so fold-A gate-RED reverts A and keeps B — the spec must preserve that independence.
